title: SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test (national component)
releaseBlockers: trademark review of the NMLS name

description: SAFE MLO: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: The SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test is developed by the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS), which the Conference of State Bank Supervisors (CSBS) and the American Association of Residential Mortgage Regulators (AARMR) developed and maintain. NMLS and related names may be trademarks of CSBS. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by NMLS, CSBS, AARMR, Prometric or the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. It is built from federal statutes and regulations and CFPB publications, which are works of the U.S. Government. It is not legal advice, and state requirements vary.

glossary.VA: the US Department of Veterans Affairs
glossary.W-2: the form an employer issues showing a worker's wages and tax withheld
glossary.FinCEN: the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, a US Treasury bureau
glossary.CSBS: the Conference of State Bank Supervisors
glossary.AARMR: the American Association of Residential Mortgage Regulators
glossary.NMLSR: the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 867 cards against the federal regulations, statutes and CFPB guides they quote, word for word as found by the card checker, and checked the two cropped CFPB form figures
checks.result: 2 wrong cards (business-day arithmetic in a rescission and a Loan Estimate scenario, and an overstated dual-compensation rule) were fixed and rechecked by hand; 6 unsupported claims, 4 ambiguous cards, 5 unclear ones and 14 minor issues were also fixed, and 3 near-duplicates removed.
